name: squirrel-docs
description: Devtime-only npm manifest carrying the markdownlint-cli2 + custom-rule pins ADR-0001 enforces. The Go operator does not ship a JS runtime; package.json and package-lock.json exist solely so `npm ci` reproduces an identical node_modules tree on every dev/CI environment and the title-case-style + max-one-sentence-per-line custom rules resolve. See the markdownlint target in the Makefile and the matching CI job for the entry points.
